children: Iveco Group becomes an indirect subsidiary of Tata Motors following the completion of the initial tender offer settlement on 30 October
Tata Motors has completed the initial settlement of its tender offer for Iveco Group N.V., acquiring an 89.42 per cent stake in the Italian commercial vehicle manufacturer.
Following the transaction, Iveco Group has become an indirect subsidiary of Tata Motors.

TML CV Holdings B.V., an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Motors, acquired 238,157,212 common shares of Iveco, representing approximately 89.42 per cent of its common share capital, net of treasury shares.
The settlement was completed on 30 October 2026.

The acquisition was made through a cash consideration of Euro 14.4 per share. Tata Motors disclosed the transaction under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
The company said the combination would bring together two businesses with complementary product portfolios and capabilities, with limited overlap in their industrial and geographical footprints.
The transaction is expected to create a more diversified business with a stronger global presence.
Founded in 1975 and headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, Iveco Group operates across commercial vehicles, powertrain technologies, buses and financial services.
Its portfolio includes the IVECO truck brand, FPT powertrain business, IVECO BUS and HEULIEZ, along with IVECO CAPITAL.
The group employs around 33,000 people and operates 16 industrial sites and 22 research and development centres.

Iveco reported revenue from operations of Euro 13.43 billion in calendar year 2025, compared with Euro 14.42 billion in 2024 and Euro 15.98 billion in 2023. The 2023 figure includes revenue from its defence business, which is not part of the current transaction perimeter.
The acquisition gives Tata Motors a larger international commercial vehicle footprint and expands its presence across trucks, buses and powertrain technologies.
